en: Huh? What do you want now?
My affection level
Monokuma's instructions
Nothing in particular
Are you unsure of something?
<CLT=cltMIND>I wanted to ask Monokuma about...

Alright! Let's take a look at your affection
level, Shuichi!

After all, the most important person you
can love is yourself.

How's anyone supposed to fall in love with
you if you don't love yourself...?

Huh? You wanna hear something with a
little more substance?

Hmm... This feels like a rule violation, but...
in your case, I'll make an exception.

Once your affection for someone is half full,
spending time with them won't be enough.

The honeymoon phase only lasts so long before
you gotta step up your love game.

For a person like that, get a Date Ticket from
the casino and take them out on a date.

A change of scenery will let them see you in a
new light. Maybe even fall in love with you.

But remember, you can't invite someone on
a date unless your affection is half full.

Also, if someone invites you on a date, you
should go—even if you're not that into them.

It won't cost you a ticket and it won't take
too long, so it's not a waste of your time.

Anyway, do your best, Romeo! I'll be watching
along with the audience!

You're a weirdo for coming to this place.
Can't you see there's nothing here?
Hm? Then what am I doing here?

Some questions in life are best left
unanswered...

<CLT=cltMIND>100 casino coins were handed
to me, laced with implication.

Oh my, there's no reason for you to come to
this place...
*gasp!* Unless...you came to see me!?
What do I do, what do I do...?
Love between a human and a bear...
But...there's no right way to fall in love...
BLURRRRRRRRRRRRRRRRRGH!
Urgh... I feel sick from overthinking...

<CLT=cltMIND>She gave me 5 casino coins
as an allowance.

Are you sure? You're wasting your time
coming here, you know that?

But if you wanna see me that badly, then
I won't stop you...

*gasp!* Is this about the coins!? Have you been
using me for my money this whole time!?

<CLT=cltMIND>She gave me 3 casino coins
as an allowance.
HELLO. THERE-IS-NOTHING-HERE...

TECHNICALLY, THAT-MEANS-THERE-IS-
"NOTHING-HERE" HERE.

<CLT=cltMIND>He discreetly handed me 5 casino coins
and left the way I came...
DID-YOU-KNOW, DETECTIVE?
FATHER-ONLY-EATS-SALMON.

<CLT=cltMIND>He discreetly handed me 12 casino coins
and left the way I came...
UP-UP-DOWN-DOWN...
LEFT-RIGHT-LEFT-RIGHT-B-A...

<CLT=cltMIND>He discreetly handed me 7 casino coins
and left the way I came...

ITCHY...
TASTY...

<CLT=cltMIND>He discreetly handed me 300 casino coins
and left the way I came...

Byeow! This wishy-washy, lovey-dovey bullcrap
ain't doin' anything for me!

I bet shovin' Monodam in a scalding hot bath
will heat things up!
<CLT=cltMIND>I got 5 casino coins flung at me.

Hell yeah! We're only doin' this lame crap cuz
Papa Kuma's got a screw loose or somethin'!

But once Act 2 starts, all hell's gonna break
loose! You can count on it!

First, I'll sacrifice Monodam and summon
the Demon Supermen!
<CLT=cltMIND>I got 2 casino coins flung at me.
Hell yeah!

Byeow-nyeow-nyeow! My pain's a tattoo that's
been etched on me for liiiiiiife!

Byeow-nyeow-nyeow! If I say I regret it, that
would be such a liiiiiiiie!
<CLT=cltMIND>I got 4 casino coins flung at me.
There's no one past this point!

I'm the red Monokub! That means I'm a main
character, so I don't tell lies!

But then, why do they call them "bright red 
lies"?
Are lies red? Does that mean I'm a liar?

You came a schlong way, just to talk to me?
I knew you had great taste!

Since you got such great taste, lemme give
you some advice!

Even in a reality dating show, sometimes the
hard-ons of life can become too much...

That's why it's important to relax every now
and then!

Especially when life comes at you with
a hard-on! Got it?

Did you know girls' panties don't have
a weiner flap? Monophanie said so!
...That's all I got.
Nothin' to see here. Move along.

Actually, you can't go any further. There's
grown-up business beyond this point.
You know what I'm talkin' about, don'tcha?

Wastin' your life takin' marchin' orders from
lame-ass adults... Sounds familiar, don't it?

But it's not too late. You can still alter the
course of your life.

Well, not now, of course. Your options are
a bit more limited at the moment.
Didn't I tell ya there was nothin' to see here?
Wait a minute...

Do you think I'll let you through if ya just
keep talkin' my ear off?

Not gonna work. You gotta fight with the
cards you've been dealt.

Even if tournament rules are in place, and all
your cards are on the ban list...

Eh? What're you talkin' to me for?
Are you too scared to find true love?

There's nothin' stupider than being too
scared to fall in love!

No matter how much ya stress over it, you
can never know what others are thinkin'!

The only guarantee in life is that ya can't go
anyhere unless ya take that first step!

And once you're movin, there's nothing else
you can do except crash and burn!

But, uh, if ya *do* end up crashin' and burnin',
don't tell anyone it was my idea.
